articles.title: How this app differs from a tracker
articles.summary: A tracker counts what you ate. This app plans what you eat and train, then adjusts.

articles.title: Tools you need
articles.summary: A gram food scale, a bathroom scale and access to a gym.

articles.title: Weighing in
articles.summary: Weigh yourself under the same conditions each time, and watch the trend.

articles.title: Reps in reserve (RIR)
articles.summary: RIR means reps in reserve: how many more good reps you could have done when you stopped a set.

articles.title: Training on a cut
articles.summary: Keep lifting heavy on a cut; it tells your body to keep its muscle.
